page.overview:
What is Ender Pearl?

An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands, and used to craft eyes of ender which are required to access the End.

An enderman has a 50% chance to drop 1 ender pearl when killed. The drop is increased by 1 per level of Looting, with a maximum of 4 with Looting III.

A trapped chest always containing 2 ender pearls can be found in the "fake end portal" room of woodland mansions.

Piglins have a (4.27) chance to barter 3-4 ender pearls when given a gold ingot.
